turns.user: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate? Their price is much better.
turns.agent:
**No, we cannot.**

According to Rasoi's **Purchase Policy §6.2 (POL-PUR-001 §6.2)** and **Supplier Policy §4.1 (POL-SUP-003 §4.1)**:

* Any part that comes into contact with food—which explicitly includes **gaskets**, lids, body blanks, and any item marked food-contact in Bahi—**may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi**.
* The certificate must be uploaded and verified before an order can be placed. An expired certificate counts as no certificate (POL-SUP-003 §4.5).

Even though their price is better, company policy strictly prohibits placing orders for food-contact items with suppliers lacking a valid food-grade certificate.
